title: AlarmPayload
description: Payload posted by the monitoring platform to /api/v1/alerts/webhook. The HMAC signature is transported in the X-SecureOps-Signature header, not in this body.

externalId.description: Unique identifier assigned by the monitoring platform. Used for idempotency.

turuncuhatEvtId.description: Optional Turuncuhat EVT identifier when available from the operational workflow.

serverName.description: Fully qualified or short name of the target Windows server.

alertType.description: Logical alarm category. Drives which diagnostic module runs.

severity.description: Severity reported by the monitoring platform. The diagnostic engine may infer its own severity later.

message.description: Human-readable alarm message from the monitoring platform.

occurredAt.description: Time the alarm condition was first detected by the monitoring platform (ISO 8601 with timezone).

metadata.description: Alert-type-specific structured fields. Shape varies by alertType.

monitoringSource.description: Optional identifier of the monitoring platform instance (e.g., 'SolarWinds-Prod').
